Question: I just want to say that can you please make duaa for me because my iman is very weak and am falling apart please can you also tell me what can i do? Answer ID: 3853 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 87/87=M) In order to strengthen Imaan first we have to rectify the yaqeen (belief) of our heart, believe truly in the promises and punishments declared by Allah, reflect upon the signs Allah's power, study the Imaan chapters of the Quran and Hadith and read carefully the accounts and events of the prophets and the companions. We should take lessons from the incidents of the people who were inflicted punishment from Allah, assess daily our deeds, thank Allah on good deeds and try to avoid bad deeds. We should join deeni meetings, adopt company of good Muslims, refrain from the company of worldly and materialist people, hold discussions about Imaan and seek repentance from Allah in case commit any sin. It is advisable to you to give your hand in the hand ( bai'ah ) of any pious and follower of sunnah sheikh and try to abide by his dictates while getting some time for going into Tableegh . May Allah enable all of us to do the same! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
